trigger: A request proposes Lua scripting, embedding, sandboxing, VM state, host callbacks, LuaJIT, or Lua-authored dynamic logic.
steps: Read AGENTS.md, harness doctrine, Lua manifest, Lua embedding contract, codebase map, and scoped skill.
Classify each requested behavior as host-owned, Lua-owned, shared interface, or out-of-scope.
Reject product/runtime mutation in a harness-only sprint and record the required downstream runtime owner.
Select embedding-design-validation when architecture/lifecycle is changing; select sandbox-validation when capability exposure or untrusted scripts are involved.
Record unresolved version/API/resource-limit dependencies before any runtime promotion.
outputs: exact next validator or downstream sprint gate
failureHandling: If ownership is ambiguous, stop mutation and produce the boundary map first.
If the request implies OS/IO access without an allow-list, route to sandbox-validation and fail closed.
